traceTitle: auth/DoA/doa-notification-creation.spec.ts:33 › Delegated Organisation - Notification Creation › Carol Clark (agent) creates for Plant Org 1 → notification assigned to Plant Org 1 with Trade Partner badge
crossTypeNote: Cross-type evidence observed with a CHED-PP Plant-organisation fixture. CHED-P is a POAO application; this finding applies only the rendered delegated-authority mechanism and does not infer any POAO-specific journey detail.
journeySummary: Carol Clark creates a CHED-PP notification on behalf of IPAFFS Plant Organisation 1. The agent selects a different organisation, selects Plant Organisation 1, submits, and sees the resulting notification assigned to the client organisation with a Trade Partner badge.

delegatedAgentPagesAndControls.page: Who are you creating this notification for?

observations.meaning: The agent's own organisation is an available creation owner.
The agent can choose to create on behalf of another organisation.

delegatedAgentPagesAndControls.page: Which company is this notification for

observations.verbatim: IPAFFS Plant Organisation 1 KAINOS SOFTWARE LTD, 4-6 UPPER CRESCENT BELFAST BT7 1NT
observations.accessibleName: IPAFFS Plant Organisation 1 KAINOS SOFTWARE LTD, 4-6 UPPER CRESCENT BELFAST BT7 1NT
observations.meaning: A represented client organisation is selectable as the notification company.

observations.verbatim: CHED status: New; Trade Partner; Consignee: IPAFFS Plant Organisation 1
observations.meaning: The submitted client-organisation notification is visibly distinguished as trade-partner work and names the client organisation as consignee.

observations.verbatim: Copy as new; View details; Amend
observations.accessibleName: Copy as new / View details / Amend
observations.meaning: The delegated notification card exposes the normal post-submission actions to the agent.

visibilityOwnershipRules.rule: An agent can create for their own agency or choose a represented organisation through a distinct on-behalf-of selection.
When Plant Organisation 1 is selected, the submitted notification is assigned to that client organisation rather than the agent's agency and is marked Trade Partner.

limitations: This trace creates CHED-PP with a Plant organisation and supplies no POAO-specific rendered detail.
This trace demonstrates submitted ownership and the Trade Partner badge; it does not test draft visibility.
